items.title: z_goal / residue_wanting -> behaviour observational coupling (906c instrument on 916a-repaired substrate)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC / OBSERVATIONAL (claim_ids=[]; experiment_purpose=diagnostic; promotes nothing). Answers organism-review Section 3 Level A (observational coupling) for residue_wanting for the FIRST time, and re-checks z_goal against 906c's near-null now that a matched-substrate comparison is possible. Combines V3-EXQ-906c's coupling instrument (lagged Pearson r + Spearman rho of affect[t] vs behaviour[t+1..t+3], ported byte-for-byte) with V3-EXQ-916a's residue_wanting writer fix (substrate copied VERBATIM: use_proxy_fields=True, tonic_5ht_enabled=True, update_benefit_salience() wired). Before 916a, residue_wanting was hard-0 across the whole 906-family lineage, so the wanting half of 906c's instrument was NEVER exercised on live data; 916a's landed run confirmed residue_wanting varies (chan_max_std=0.568) and z_goal too (0.078). NEW couplings: residue_wanting[t] -> approach / benefit_exposure (real resource acquisition) / locomotion / departure-from-refuge at t+1..t+3. Pre-registered non-trivial floor: |r| or |rho| >= 0.15 with n >= 200 (906c's r~0.07 is the 'no coupling' reference); readiness gate requires residue_wanting to vary this run or it self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue. OBSERVATIONAL NOT CAUSAL -- a lagged correlation does not establish the signal DRIVES behaviour (common-cause confounds); the causal-necessity test is the SEPARATE ablation V3-EXQ-931 (CEM wanting_weight), which this does not duplicate. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (residue_wanting->behaviour lagged r) recorded in NO manifest -- 906c computed no wanting coupling and its z_goal couplings ran on the residue_wanting=0 substrate; 916a records channel std but zero coupling_* fields -> not recoverable, run. Also evidences EVB-0157 / substrate_queue mech203-valence-pool-admissibility (non-degenerate benefit valence-pool read off a trained substrate) as a side effect. Run on a cloud worker (linux-x86_64) for machine-class match with 916a. Smoke PASS (dry-run: coupling machinery fires, wanting->benefit_exposure r=0.29 on the tiny sample; underpowered n<200 correctly self-routes coupling_underpowered_requeue). NOTE: appended alongside a pre-existing UNCOMMITTED working-tree V3-EXQ-929 (sleep_gap9) edit that was not on origin/main -- preserved additively, not authored by this session.

items.title: MECH-357 agent-directed hazard pursuit Stage-H retest (6th pressure candidate; 603s+directedness)
